post.caption:
Your heart beat 100,000 times. Did you thank Allah once? 🤍

“For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.” (94:5)

This morning, before noon: thank Him for 10 things. Your eyes, your breath, the people you love. Alhamdulillah. 🤲
post.youtube_title: Your heart beat 100,000 times. Did you thank Allah once? 🤍 #islam #alhamdulillah

captions: 9:40. Room 214. Dad’s heart, on a screen.
You count every beep. You never counted yours.
Then his hand moves. Cold. Weak.
You walk to the sink. Cold water on your hands.
You go back. You hold his hand. And you thank Him.
